previewLayerPurge.policy: CODEX_PREVIEW cleanup is scoped-only. Without an explicit bbox, legacy proof geometry is normalized to ASSET_PROOF_CONTENT instead of deleted.

protectedContentBeforeNormalize.policy: Only non-shelf-layer entities are treated as protected reusable asset content; shelf labels, frames and evidence must avoid these bboxes.

contentLayerNormalization.policy: Visible legacy proof panels are kept as protected asset evidence, but not left on CODEX_PREVIEW.

protectedContentReadback.policy: Only non-shelf-layer entities are treated as protected reusable asset content; shelf labels, frames and evidence must avoid these bboxes.

rackPlan.entryPolicy: 先看 00_INDEX，按 rackId / slotId 入库；来源不清先进 03_REVIEW_QUARANTINE。

warehouseArchitecture.expansionPolicy: 先扩展分类内大货架和空货位；对象 block 本体进入各自分类 DWG，standard_assets.dwg 只保留跨库索引。

acceptanceCriteria.slotContainment: 每个资产槽必须有 owning rack、slotId、状态和可回读 bbox 所属区。
acceptanceCriteria.assetOwnership: 已占用槽记录 assetIds；对象索引槽记录 category/nativeDwg。
acceptanceCriteria.expansionCapacity: 每个大类货架必须声明空位或未来扩展位，不能画成说明卡片。
acceptanceCriteria.copyPolicy: 只有 clean source 槽能作为复制源；索引、复审、隔离、证据和标签默认 never_copy。
acceptanceCriteria.screenshotBoundary: 截图只辅助人工看图；created handles、zone bbox、slot ownership 和 readback 才是机器证据。

displayPolicy.copySafety: 可视标签、货架边框、证据和预留卡槽默认 copyPolicy=never_copy；style asset 优先复用命名样式定义。
